Industry · Industrial & Manufacturing Know Every Path into Your Production Systems.

Every link between the plant floor and the corporate network was approved by someone competent. Together they made a set of paths into production. Can anyone still draw them?

02

Three Gaps in Industrial Estates

I

Production Systems were Never Designed to be Reachable.

Plant networks were built for isolation and then connected, one justified integration at a time. Try drawing those paths from memory and see how far you get.

II

Your Supplier Estate Grew Faster Than the Process Assessing It.

Standing vendor access is granted during commissioning and rarely revisited. Check when your production supplier accounts were last reviewed, and by whom.

III

Shadow AI is Already in Production Planning.

Scheduling and forecasting tools with model behaviour arrive through operations budgets. Is anything in your planning stack making decisions that nobody has classified as a system?

04

Common Questions

What does an industrial network assessment cover?

Which systems can issue an instruction to production equipment, under what authorisation, and what record exists afterwards.

Does the UAE PDPL apply to a manufacturer with no consumer customers?

Yes, wherever employee or partner personal data is processed, regardless of whether you sell to consumers.

Do you assess SCADA or production control systems directly?

We assess the paths into them and the authorisation around them, rather than testing live control systems.

Can an assessment run without stopping production?

Yes — nothing in the engagement requires downtime, and scope is agreed in writing before work starts.

Is optimisation software in scope as an AI system?

If it influences a decision that reaches equipment or scheduling, it is in scope regardless of what it is called internally.
